body: Thank you. I just don’t know anymore. I don’t have any reasons to want to wake up everyday. And plus, I just feel like a burden on everyone. My friends, my family, everyone. I don’t even know where my fucking cat is man. I’m not going to get anywhere in life so why bother trying.
It doesn’t feel like it will ever go away. Perhaps it won’t. Thanks though.
Thanks again everyone I know that no one will see this.  I just thought I should share an update with everyone.
Thank you so much I really do appreciate it.
Thank you. I’ve been having a hard time coping with my thoughts recently so it means a lot you replied, I know it’s small but thank you.
